journey.name: MOD-07: 平台设置与安全控制
journey.description: 验证用户打开平台设置界面，调节主题偏好（浅色、深色、跟随系统）、切换动态取色开关与减弱动态效果开关；校验开发者信任模式状态切换和插件紧急熔断交互流程。

actions.action: Click the "设置" action icon in top bar
Verify that the "设置与平台管理" screen or bottom sheet is displayed
Verify that the theme selection chips "浅色", "深色", "跟随系统" are visible
Verify that the "深色" chip is selected
Click the "减弱动态效果" switch
Swipe down on the settings view to locate security controls
Verify that "开发者信任模式" or "紧急熔断所有插件" button is visible
Click the "返回" icon or close button
Verify that the workbench is displayed with the updated settings applied
